references.text: Parallel account of God's oath that the evil generation shall not see the promised land
God declares that all over twenty years old shall die in the wilderness and not enter the promised land
Reiteration of God's oath that those who left Egypt shall not see the land He swore to give to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob
Reference to the land the Lord swore to give to the fathers Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob
God's oath in His anger that they shall not enter into His rest
Quoting Psalm 95 about God's oath that they shall not enter into His rest, as a warning against unbelief
Reference to the disobedient Israelites who were not allowed to enter the land because of unbelief
The original oath to Abraham to give the land to his descendants
God's oath to Isaac to give the lands to his descendants, as He swore to Abraham
